proposition: repair_card_route_exposable is true exactly when the instruction is FixSiteReady and the readiness authority reports repair_ready.
non_claims: This claim does not establish that the repair instruction or readiness facts were produced from current repository evidence.
This claim does not establish correctness of repair execution, edit application, or downstream verification.
domain: Every FixInstructionState constructor selected from the exhaustive, duplicate-checked FIX_INSTRUCTION_STATES domain and both boolean repair_ready values.
assumptions: The symbolic usize instruction index is constrained below FIX_INSTRUCTION_STATES.len(); the generated exhaustive match rejects omitted, duplicated, or newly added production constructors.
trust_dependencies: CBMC solver execution and result reporting
the pinned Rust verifier toolchain and target configuration
required_covers: FixSiteReady without repair readiness remains closed
negative_controls: Mutation control: expose a route for stale/unavailable instructions or without repair readiness.
Compiler control: omit or duplicate a constructor, or add a production enum variant without extending the proof domain; the generated guard must reject compilation.
Guard-removal control: removing the exhaustive guard permits an omitted constructor while ordinary behavior tests remain green; those tests alone do not establish domain completeness.
result_satisfaction: One current verified row for the registered subject with every required constructor, open-route and fail-closed cover satisfied and no unreachable cover.
currentness_inputs: provider, solver and Rust toolchain identity
runner generation and effective verifier configuration
actual admitted merge-group and ordered member heads
transition_policy: base_and_head_remain_protected_until_an_explicit_generation-bumped replacement or recorded retirement is accepted
